description: This file defines Drupal behaviors related to block administration, including filtering the block list by text input and highlighting newly placed blocks.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches behaviors for filtering blocks by text and highlighting block placement.

methods.name: filterBlockList
methods.description: Filters the block list based on the input query, showing or hiding blocks accordingly.

methods.name: toggleBlockEntry
methods.description: Shows or hides a block entry based on whether its label matches the search query.
